sources.entry: codex-profiles - Selects named CODEX_HOME profiles and, on macOS, named ChatGPT Desktop windows with separate local state, without copying tokens. #free #opensource

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app and Bash-based CLI (codex-profile) that switch between named CODEX_HOME profiles and open separate named ChatGPT Desktop windows, each with its own local state and no copied tokens.
summary.what_it_does: Codex Profiles provides a native AppKit menu bar app on macOS for creating and opening profiles, each with separate local state. Profiles can open in their own named ChatGPT Desktop window or launch the Codex CLI in Terminal. The menu shows each profile's remaining Codex CLI quota, low-quota warnings and reset times, and can display the lowest percentage beside the menu bar icon. Folders can be bound to profiles, pinned, and opened via search or keyboard shortcuts, without changing project files. The same profiles are available through the codex-profile CLI, which runs on macOS and Linux and includes commands such as setup, cli, app, workspace bind, run, usage and doctor. A Raycast extension is also described, built from source.
use_cases: Keep personal, work and client Codex or ChatGPT sessions separate
Open several ChatGPT Desktop windows side by side under different accounts
Check remaining Codex CLI quota per profile before starting work
Launch Codex CLI in a specific profile from the terminal
Bind project folders to profiles and open them quickly
Colour-code profiles in the shell prompt and launchers
notable: Separates profiles by local state and CODEX_HOME directory without copying authentication files or cookies
Opens the original signed ChatGPT Desktop app in named windows, each with separate Chat, Work and Codex state
Menu bar app bundles the codex-profile CLI, so both share the same profiles and project bindings
Per-profile quota rings with low-quota alerts and optional menu bar badge
Keyboard-driven menu with global shortcut, search and ⌘1–9 row access
caveats: Signed app download is not yet published; currently must build from source on macOS 13+ with Xcode Command Line Tools
Local-state separation is explicitly not an account, OS or server-side security boundary; separate OS users are recommended for stronger isolation
ChatGPT windows need the official ChatGPT desktop app; quota and Terminal launches need the official Codex CLI
Desktop app features are macOS-only; the Raycast extension is not in the Raycast Store and must be built from source
